question: Which of the following persons was named as Dean of Harvard Business School in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Srikant Datar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian-origin academician Srikant Datar has been named as Dean of Harvard Business School.**
 
• **He succeeded Nitin Nohria.**
 
• He **became the second consecutive dean hailing from India **to lead the prestigious 112-year-old institution.
 
• **In 2021, he was awarded the Padma Shri,** the fourth-highest civilian award in India.
 
• **He has served as Senior Associate Dean for University Affairs for Research, Executive Education, and administration.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanjit Roy**

 
 
• **Sanjit Roy is a social activist and teacher.**
 
• He is the **founder and director of Barefoot College in Rajasthan**, India.
 
• It is a **non-governmental organization offering practical training** to poor and rural communities.
 
• **In 2010, Roy was selected as one of TIME Magazine's 100 most influential figures** for his work within rural communities.
 
• **Skills taught in college such as solar engineering have been adopted in over 50 of the world’s least developed countries.**
 
 
 
• **Nitin Nohria​**
 
 
• ​Nitin Nohria served as the **tenth dean of Harvard Business School from 2010-2020.**
 
• He previously **served as co-chair of the Leadership Initiative, Senior Associate Dean of Faculty Development, and Head of the Organizational Behavior unit.**
 
 
 
• **Achyuta Samanta​**
 
 
• ​Prof. Achyuta Samanta is **an educationist, humanitarian, and statesman.**
 
• He founded a University in 2004, KIIT, **Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology.**
 
• He **also founded the Kalinga Institute of Social Sciences (KISS)** for providing **education to indigenous boys and girls, free of cost.**
